# BackButton

The round back control at the top-left of every screen below the top level (show detail, season episodes, settings).

`TVTracker.BackButton` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.BackButton />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.BackButton"></x-import>
```

## Props (BackButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `string` | Where to go; renders a link. Without it, a button calling onClick. |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name; default "Back". |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  |
